title: senecio lanibracteus
intro: Senecio lanibracteus, commonly known as the African fire plant, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Senecio lanibracteus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids. However, more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for human consumption.
